[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] '''Ligg Panat''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Krish (species)/Legends|Krish]] serving in [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] at the start of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]]. Flying under [[Rogue Leader/Legends|Rogue Leader]] [[Gavin Darklighter]], she had the callsign [[Rogue Seven/Legends|Rogue Seven]], and she approached [[Starfighter combat/Legends|combat]] as though it were a game, reflecting her [[Species/Legends|species']] enthusiasm for sport and play.

==Biography==
Ligg Panat, a [[Krish (species)/Legends|Krish]] [[Gender|female]], was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who served in the famed [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] at the start of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. She was a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] who flew as [[Rogue Seven/Legends|Rogue Seven]]. At the beginning of that war, Rogue Squadron were recruited by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Traest Kre'fey]] of the [[New Republic Defense Fleet]] to investigate the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] after a report from [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] of an invading [[Praetorite Vong|alien force]] was met with disinterest by the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]].

Officially, the Rogues would be simulating [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] attacks on Kre'fey's [[Bothan Assault Cruiser]], the ''[[Ralroost]]'', so as not to openly defy the Senate. In the Outer Rim, Panat and the rest of the Rogues [[Third skirmish in the Outer Rim|faced off]] against the [[Yorik-et|coralskipper]] fighter craft of the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]], and two members of the squadron, [[Tik (Rogue Squadron)|Tik]] and [[Dinger]], were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a miniature [[Black hole/Legends|black hole]] created by the coralskippers' [[dovin basal]] vortices.

The Rogues faced off against more coralskippers while the ''Ralroost'' helped [[Evacuation of Dubrillion|evacuate]] [[Agamarian]] [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] from [[Dubrillion/Legends|Dubrillion]]. Without enough supplies for a long-distance [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump, the [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] carrying the refugees landed on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], and Rogue Squadron were part of a small force that defended them from a Yuuzhan Vong onslaught in the [[Battle of Dantooine (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Battle of Dantooine]]. Panat was one of six Rogue pilots who were killed by coralskippers in the battle, which also saw Yuuzhan Vong [[Warrior caste|warriors]] murder half of the refugees. The survivors were relocated to [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]] before the remaining Rogues returned to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] aboard the ''Ralroost''.
